'''Shurg''' was a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]], whose [[Shurg's Gamorrean clan|clan]] had taken over an abandoned [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] [[Jundland Czerka facility|facility]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Timely Arrival" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Shurg made a deal with Czerka official [[Gayem Leksende]]: Gamorreans would let Czerka personnel retrieve data they needed from the facility, while in exchange their clan would receive weapons and [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]]. However, a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] citizen, sent by [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] operative [[Fauler]] to retrieve the data, attacked the abandoned facility, and Shurg was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the confrontation.<ref name="Timely Arrival" />
